blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — A song meant to welcome President Marcos during his visit here has drawn scrutiny from some netizens—not because of its popularity, but because of the meaning behind its lyrics. The President arrived in Shenzhen at 5:30 p.m. on Nov. 18 for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting. He and first lady Liza Araneta Marcos went straight to the Shenzhen International Communication Center for the official welcome ceremony for Apec leaders.
